profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's website presents Claude as its primary AI, describing it as built for problem solvers and suited to complex challenges including data analysis, code writing, and general reasoning tasks.

Anthropic's tracked products include Claude, a general-purpose large language model assistant available at claude.ai, and Claude Code, an agentic coding tool. The company also offers the Anthropic Console, an API management platform with tools for prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as a Computer Use agent that enables desktop automation and computer control at a system level.

The held facts show Anthropic carrying significant litigation exposure, with twelve active cases across multiple federal courts. These include several suits in the Northern District of California, cases in the District of Delaware, Hawaii, Vermont, and Eastern Pennsylvania, and one matter before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. One case, University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC, was filed in the District of Delaware. The company's tracked legal exposure is concentrated in California, where 161 matters are recorded.
